description: Pareto distribution quantile function x_m (1 - p)^(-1/alpha)

tolerance.reason: p is an exact double; 1 - p is exact for p >= 1/2, and below that rounding it costs at most 2^-53 / alpha (3.6e-15 for alpha = 2^-5) in the result. x_m (1 - p)^(-1/alpha) is then one pow, within an ulp or so, and multiplying by x_m (a power of two) is exact. 1/alpha is exact for alpha in {2^-5, 0.5, 1, 2}; for the other shapes rounding it costs |log(x/x_m)| 2^-53, at most 345.4 2^-53 = 3.8e-14 at a normal result on this grid (alpha = 0.1, p = 1 - 1e-15). 1e-13 as for the other functions; results below 2.2e-308 are judged relative to that number (conventions)
